modules.title: Quantum Basics
modules.description: Introduction to the principles of quantum mechanics, including wave-particle duality and superposition.

modules.title: Superposition and Entanglement
modules.description: This module explores the fundamental principles of superposition and entanglement in quantum computing, including their implications for measurement and information processing.

resources.title: Linear combination

modules.title: Quantum Gates and Operations
modules.description: This module introduces the fundamental quantum gates and operations that form the basis of quantum computing. Students will learn about the different types of quantum gates, their applications, and how to perform basic quantum operations. By the end of this module, students should be able to understand how quantum gates are used to manipulate quantum states.

modules.title: Quantum Algorithms
modules.description: This module introduces students to the fundamental quantum algorithms, including Shor's algorithm, Grover's algorithm, and Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA). Students will learn how to implement these algorithms using quantum circuits and understand their applications in various fields. By the end of this module, students should be able to design and analyze quantum algorithms.

modules.title: Quantum Error Correction
modules.description: This module introduces the principles and techniques of quantum error correction, including fault-tolerant quantum computation and surface codes.

resources.title: Quantum error correction

modules.title: Quantum Computing Hardware
modules.description: This module covers the fundamental principles and design of quantum computing hardware, including qubits, quantum gates, and quantum error correction. It also explores the different types of quantum computing architectures and their applications. Students will learn how to analyze and optimize the performance of quantum computing systems.

modules.title: Quantum Simulation
modules.description: This module explores the concept of quantum simulation, where a quantum computer is used to simulate the behavior of complex quantum systems. Students will learn how to design and implement quantum simulations for various applications, including chemistry and materials science. The module will also cover advanced topics such as quantum error correction and noise mitigation.

modules.title: Quantum Machine Learning
modules.description: This module explores the intersection of quantum computing and machine learning, covering topics such as quantum neural networks, quantum k-means clustering, and quantum support vector machines.

modules.title: Quantum Cryptography
modules.description: Quantum cryptography utilizes quantum mechanics to secure communication. It leverages the principles of superposition and entanglement to create unbreakable encryption methods.
